notes:
Lead: Saffron Queueworks (former enterprise retail brand support) looking to replace brittle rules-based tagging. CRM snippets below, copied from AE notes and call transcripts. 

- Customer environment: Zendesk Suite (Support + Talk) with ~750 agents globally. Heavy EU traffic; want data residency in EU for ticket contents. Integrations: Salesforce for account sync, internal tools via webhooks.
- Primary pain: agents spend 30-60s per ticket reading long email threads; current macros only catch ~45% of cases. Business goal: reduce handle time by 20% and auto-tag 60% of incoming tickets with >=90% precision.
- Workload & targets: mostly ticket summarization + tag prediction on email and web-form tickets. Typical ticket length 200-800 words, 90% need 1-2 sentence summary. Real-time agent assist must appear within agent UI <500ms ideally; background auto-tagging TTL up to 2s acceptable. Peak throughput: baseline 600 reqs/min, spikes to 3600 reqs/min for promo windows.
- Model preferences: prefer open-models with quantized weights on Dedicated capacity for cost predictability. Want a fallback hosted larger model for complex extraction. Request routing by region + fallback to cheaper model variant.
- Reliability needs: graceful degradation during spikes, must preserve high-priority SLA tickets (VIP customers) and route to Dedicated pool first. Caching of repeated prefixes for automated billing questions important.
- Security: SSO/SAML mandatory; KMS for key management; audit logging required for all inference events; retention controls to purge ticket text after 90 days; EU residency requested.
- Integrations requested: Zendesk trigger flow examples, sample macros for 1-click insert of Redwood summary, webhook for tag accept/reject events to feed back into Optimize. Wants prebuilt Zapier/Freshdesk-like playbooks but starting with Zendesk.
- Quote from Head of Support: "If we can consistently cut AHT by 20% without false positives in tagging, this is a no-brainer. But security has to be airtight."
- Stubs/links: Fireflies meeting (https://app.fireflies.ai/meeting/ff_20260218_Q1-demo), Drive pricing deck, initial SOW draft in drive:/deals/saffron_queueworks/sow_draft.docx, Gmail thread id 17c9d9f0b2b3a5a0 for vendor negotiation.

POC plan summary: two-week sandbox -> week 1 accuracy sweep on historical tickets (10k sample) + tag model evaluation, week 2 live shadowing in Zendesk (no UI disrupt) then 3-day controlled rollout to 50 agents. Success criteria: precision >=90% on auto-tags, average summary length 1.5 sentences, live latency median <400ms for in-UI assist.

Notes from AE: "Can we demo fallback routing and Quantized 8-bit model speed in the POC? Procurement needs estimated monthly cost for Dedicated pool at 500 concurrent sessions."

Open items: legal redlines on data residency paragraph; KMS architecture diagram requested by security (shared drive link).
